headline: 4 program/account addresses catalogued on Solana from GitHub Anchor.toml and README; no EVM presence; 11 historical audits found; on-chain reads blocked (Solana not supported by DeFiPunkd API).

findings.text: D1: Solana is the only chain; DeFiPunkd block-explorer surfacer only supports EVM chainIds; Solscan/Solana Explorer fetch not attempted (no prior URL in context). Zero addresses surfaced from EVM explorers — not applicable. Recorded in unknowns.

D2: No dedicated deployed-contracts doc page found. The Anchor.toml in the GitHub repo (https://github.com/0dotxyz/marginfi-v2/blob/main/Anchor.toml) is the authoritative deployment artifact, listing mainnet program ID MFv2hWf31Z9kbCa1snEPYctwafyhdvnV7FZnsebVacA. No separate docs/deployments page discovered; protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to the Anchor.toml URL.

D3: Audit directory at https://github.com/mrgnlabs/marginfi-v2/tree/main/audits (referenced by blog.0.xyz footer) contains 11 PDFs: OtterSec general (2023), sec3 general (Dec 2023), sec3 liquidations (Dec 2023), sec3 fixedPrice (Dec 2026), sec3 insurance (Dec 2025), sec3 AML/emode/reduce (Jan 2026), sec3 stakedCollateral (Jan 2025), Accretion emode (Jun 2025), Accretion kamino (Jun 2025), OtterSec Kamino (Jun 2025), sec3 emode (Jun 2025). No in-scope address tables extracted — PDFs not fetched individually due to fetch-call budget.

D4: Anchor.toml at main branch of 0dotxyz/marginfi-v2 lists [programs.mainnet] marginfi = MFv2hWf31Z9kbCa1snEPYctwafyhdvnV7FZnsebVacA. Also surfaces a mainnet group fixture account: 4qp6Fx6tnZkY5Wropq9wUYgtFxXKwE6viZxFHg3rdAG8 (labeled mainnet_group.json). README describes a 'Group' overseen by a 'secure governance MS' (multisig). No broadcast/run-latest.json found in this Anchor-based Solana repo (Solana Anchor does not use Foundry broadcast artifacts).
D5: Only one chain (Solana). No multi-chain enumeration needed.

D6: The marginfi program uses a Group-Bank architecture. Groups contain Banks (one per asset). Factory-discovery via DeFiPunkd read API is not possible for Solana. Solscan enumeration not attempted due to fetch-budget constraints. Recorded in unknowns.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: MFv2hWf31Z9kbCa1snEPYctwafyhdvnV7FZnsebVacA = other (Solana program/executable); 4qp6Fx6tnZkY5Wropq9wUYgtFxXKwE6viZxFHg3rdAG8 = other (mainnet Group state account, admin overseeing all Banks). README says Group admin is 'typically a secure governance MS' (multisig) — actor_class = unknown pending on-chain verification.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to Anchor.toml fetched in this run. Global Fee State Admin and Group admin multisig addresses not yet resolved to a specific public key — recorded in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked protocol website, GitHub org (0dotxyz), marginfi-v2 repository (Anchor.toml + README), the mrgnlabs audits directory, and the blog. On-chain verification via DeFiPunkd API is not available for Solana; Solscan/explorer enumeration was not completed due to fetch-budget exhaustion. 11 audit PDFs identified but not individually opened. Grade remains unknown per discovery slice rules.

protocol_metadata.about: Project 0 is the first DeFi-native prime broker on Solana, enabling users to borrow against their entire cross-venue crypto portfolio in a single unified margin account. It is built on the marginfi v2 on-chain program (a decentralized borrow-lending protocol with Group/Bank/Account architecture) and integrates external venues such as Kamino, Drift, and Save so that collateral held anywhere in a user's portfolio counts toward a single health factor. The protocol inserts a self-custodial account between the user and each underlying venue to enable portfolio-wide deleveraging and protect solvency without requiring users to move assets away from the venues they already use.
